title: 第一篇 入世 第十七章 初学功法显神奇 受困近月终得离第一篇 入世 第十八章 离得山洞困北峰 山顶骷髅战的凶
content_zh:
随着山洞外的风声渐小，时间仿佛停止了一般，这地下空间内的乌凡仿佛一座雕像一般吸收着黑玉的墨色。过了不知道多长时间，乌凡慢慢睁开了眼睛，而他手中的黑玉的颜色竟然由黑变白，乌凡的眼神里多了一丝清明。
原来这些玉简大部分是玉壶宗的各种功法秘术，还有其鼎盛时分收集来的一些外门功法，正道邪道倒是都囊括其中。只是邪道功法来源不详，如果传出去玉壶宗私藏邪术，也颇有影响。所以干脆连着本门的秘法都收藏在一起，这样也不容易被人发现，而这些玉简浓缩了所有书籍的备份，以防万一。
之前北峰大劫，估计那些功法也灰飞烟灭，而现在主峰里的八成是后人所编写。虽然大体上毫无差别，但是一些新的想法的精妙之处，肯定是有所不及，乌凡忍不住暗叹了一声造化弄宗。然后便拿起手中的玉简，按那黑玉中讲述的屏息凝神，将念头打入玉简之内。
一开始乌凡屏息憋的满脸通红，根本无法凝神，后来他稳了稳心神，又多尝试了几次，发现屏息凝神的真义是心境平和。不在乎是行走还是站立，只要保持住心境不受外界影响便可。
正所谓是心神守一，静观敌动，便可以不变应万变。
渐渐掌握了技巧，乌凡这次很快就进入了老僧入定的状态。因为之前在卧溪村时，他从奇书上了解到的功法经常在头脑里演练。所以现在从玉简中汲取到的东西，他也掌握的很快。玉简中记载的东西被完整读过之后，便牢牢的烙印在了乌凡脑子里。感觉记得差不多了，乌凡微微的睁开了眼睛，只见手中的玉简的光泽变得暗淡，然后咔嚓一下化成了一地碎片。
这难道就是传说中的阅后即焚？乌凡心中蓦的生出一个奇怪的想法。又摇了摇脑袋，赶紧回想一下刚才所学的功法，要是忘了可没地方复习了。
他沉思了一下，低声念道：“刚才玉简讲的是玉壶宗的五行诀，所谓五行便是‘金木水火土’，宇宙中万物皆蕴含着五行能量，统称为‘灵’。各门各派都有独自的操控方法。而玉壶宗法诀，是将身体里的‘灵’与空气中的‘灵’沟通，用自身气力作为介质来进行控制。”
虽然听起来很别扭，但是乌凡实际上心里也是很别扭，虽然背的很熟但是实际上却一头雾水，如果有人指点还好，现在连记载的玉简都碎了，真是让人十分头疼。看外面天色渐黑，乌凡心想反正也是等死，何不来尝试一下？
乌凡记得恰巧最开始介绍的是‘五行-火字诀’，而这最开始接触的第一个法诀也让他印象深刻，便按照玉简中单系法诀描述的“火字诀，由火生，五行相克火先行；火字当头火当尾，五行相生把火生”练习起来，“五行相克火先行，应该就是火金木土水，然后火当头尾，五行相生就是木生火前面是水，对了，是土金水木火。”
念叨完这两句，乌凡回想起那日吕纯把九院弟子拖上山来，念叨着的是土来，应该就是土字诀了。那这么说来自己想的没错，于是便神色紧张的念道：“火金木土水，土金水木火，火来！”仿佛这个山洞也在为他加油，不停地回响着，火来，火来火来！
即便是有山洞的帮助，他等了好久，火却也没来，但夜色却来了，带着一群蚊虫，围着乌凡嗡嗡的叮咬。乌凡气的一跺脚，心想：对！一定是我没用力气！于是将全身力气憋在右手食指上，放在额前一尺处，指着一群蚊虫，高声喝道：“火金木土水，土金水木火，火来！”
只见一团火焰从手指上方凭空而起，那群蚊虫瞬间被烧为焦炭，乌凡得意的哈哈大笑。可那些带着火星的尸体扑扑掉落，团团小火苗将乌凡的眉头燎的精光，仿佛石室上那片被拔秃的土地一般。
山洞屋子里升起了一团篝火，乌凡手里捏着两粒丹药，没有眉毛的眉头紧皱，然后一口将两粒丹药狠狠吞下。按照五行诀的说法，自己的灵沟通出来的元素可以控制是否可以对自己造成效果。可刚才自己想杀蚊子，为什么会烧到自己，望着烧的噼里啪啦的火堆，乌凡把手探过去，果然感受到了热度，和刚才手指上的火焰感觉不同。
乌凡这次收敛了力气又用了一次法诀，这次只是一丝小小的火苗，乌凡用手去触碰，火苗缠在手指上，乌凡却感受不到丝毫温度。于是他到洞口捡了一片落叶将其点燃，果然火焰的温度升了起来。原来是因为自身的灵转移到了其他的介质上，变成了自然中的其它元素。
于是他又尝试了几次，发现果然如此，此番发现让他充分感受到了五行诀中灵的神奇，以后如果遇到意外可能会有妙用。随着尝试次数过多乌凡也感觉有些疲惫，五行诀操控元素用的是自身气力，乌凡觉得气力应该就是力气。虽然不论托着一团火苗或是团团烈火，身体上都是一样的感觉。可是实际上消耗的力气就像是分别拿着一袋铜币和扛着一袋面粉走了一段路。
所以乌凡心想五行诀的根本还是要注重自身素质锻炼，乌凡不由得感觉十分纠结，明明它是法术，为什么修炼法术却还要锻炼力量。而且现在还仅仅是单系法诀，以后要是组合起来岂不是累死个人，奇奇怪怪的，真是让人一头雾水。因为力气使用的过多，乌凡越想越累，便渐渐地睡去了。
就这样在看玉简，练习，睡觉这几件事的重复中，乌凡的眉毛也一点点的长了出来，对于五行诀的操控也更加得心应手，最初的两瓶丹药吃光之后，再吃第二瓶的时候，乌凡发现虽然服用之后，依然能填饱肚子。可却没有最初的那种神奇的感觉了，难道是因为经常服用丹药的原因，现在已经感觉索然无味了吗？
而在这之间的日子里，乌凡又背下了几片玉简，之后便练习了五行诀的其余四门法诀，俗话说一通百通，掌握了火诀之后，剩下的四门倒是还算好掌握，只不过从物质本质上来说，火和水属于自然类元素，而金木土属于物质类元素。虽然说可以通过自身内五行的灵可以与之沟通，但是火和水可以从空气的燥热和潮湿中提取转化，金木土却只有在身处环境中才能完全发挥作用。
所以说从攻击角度来说火和水的破坏力是从外界对物体进行破坏，而金木土是从环境本身进行破坏。越想乌凡越纠结，这光靠凭空想象，也难以从中感受到具体的差别和联系。之后的组合法诀他只是脑海里演练了一番也没敢付诸实际，这山洞里的房间虽然不大，但毕竟也是容身之所，万一出个意外被自己毁了，自己算是直接把自己埋了。便干脆先放到一边，继续浏览起其他的玉简来。

一晃又过去了十数日，见柜子上完整的玉简也不多了，其中大部分功法已被乌凡牢记于心。乌凡是不管好的坏的黑的白的，反正是玉简里记的东西，他是一股脑的全塞进了小脑瓜里。乌凡算算自己来到北峰也有一月有余，自己的小弟们却还没来寻找自己，心里也是暗暗赌气，回头要是能出去，定要教训他们一番。
而乌凡不知道的是此时那些弟子，已经从最开始乱锅里的蚂蚁，变成了温水中的青蛙，仿佛身体上已经适应了这种生活，双目无神，如同行尸坐肉一般。不知道什么时候可以掉下一块巨石将锅砸漏，让这些青蛙再次焕发生机。
又过了几日，乌凡终于将最后一块玉简塞完，心里感觉空落落的的躺在地上，他仿佛也适应了这种紧张又安逸生活，每天不用去想其他的事情，只是重复着前一天重复的事情，毫无新意，却也不用去想以后该怎么办。而终于到了玉简读完的这一天，不知道还有什么事情可做，乌凡陷入了一种恐惧。
丹药仿佛是算计好了一番，到现在也所剩无几，空学了一身本事却无处伸展，如果在这里饿死，还不如当初一口气灌两瓶直接撑死算了。如果山洞外面，能飞来一架石桥该多好，就像当初吕纯那样…
想到这乌凡一骨碌从地上跳起，恨不得啪啪给自己几个大嘴巴子，自己从最开始用火烧死蚊子就错了，然后从这里开始就一步一步走远了。他只想到如何用五行诀来攻击，却丝毫没想到过如何使用。就连这段时间天天用火诀生火，也觉得自己是在攻击木头。再说起木头，石屋里的柜子是木头，山外的藤蔓也属于木属性，而且漫山遍野的草木就在眼前，自己像个傻子一样，天天守着火堆，只知道玩火。
乌凡气的胸口直发闷，他来到山洞口，左手掐个虽然没什么用只是为了好看也没人看的到的剑指，右手微张，心想我直接在山体上筑出一堵石墙，然后就可以上去了，就要喝道：“土水火金木，金水木火土，土来！”
乌凡土诀刚念到一半，心里总觉得不对劲，突然想起来他跳下来的那个隐蔽的洞口，那里离地面也不高，从那上去岂不是更容易，何苦在这多费力气。真是闷的太久，整个人都傻掉了。
灰溜溜的来到了那个洞口，赌气又羞怒的高声对着脚下施了土诀，只见脚下轰隆隆作响，一个石柱在他脚下冲天而起，直接把他从洞口顶飞了出去。乌凡慌忙收了土诀，身子跟着惯性又向上飞起了一段距离，停止，落下，一屁股摔倒在他最初摔晕的位置。
content_en:
As the sound of wind outside the cave became smaller, time seemed to have stopped. Wu Fan in this underground space absorbed the ink color of black jade like a statue. After an unknown amount of time, Wu Fan slowly opened his eyes, and the color of the black jade in his hand turned from black to white, and there was a hint of clarity in Wu Fan's eyes.
It turns out that most of these jade slips are the various secret techniques of the Yuhu Sect, as well as some outer sect techniques collected during its heyday, including both righteous and evil ways. It's just that the source of the evil technique is unknown. If it is rumored that the Yu Hu Sect secretly hides the evil technique, it will be quite influential. So I simply collected all the secrets of the sect together, so that they would not be easily discovered, and these jade slips condensed the backup of all the books, just in case.
Before the great catastrophe on the North Peak, those techniques were probably wiped out, but now 80% of the techniques on the main peak were written by later generations. Although there is generally no difference, some of the new ideas are definitely not as subtle as before. Wu Fan couldn't help but sigh inwardly. Then he picked up the jade slip in his hand, held his breath and concentrated as described in the black jade, and put his thoughts into the jade slip.
At first, Wu Fan's face turned red while holding his breath, and he couldn't concentrate at all. Later, he stabilized his mind and tried a few more times, and found that the true meaning of holding his breath and concentrating was to have a peaceful mind. It doesn't matter whether you are walking or standing, as long as you keep your state of mind unaffected by the outside world.
As the saying goes, if you keep one mind and watch the enemy's movements quietly, you can remain unchanged and respond to all changes.
Gradually mastering the technique, Wu Fan quickly entered the state of meditation as an old monk. Because when he was in Woxi Village before, he often practiced the exercises he learned from strange books in his mind. So now he can grasp the things he has learned from the jade slips very quickly. After the things recorded in the jade slips were read completely, they were firmly imprinted in Wu Fan's mind. Feeling that he had almost remembered it, Wu Fan opened his eyes slightly, and saw that the luster of the jade slip in his hand dimmed, and then clicked into pieces.
Is this the legendary burning after reading? Wu Fan suddenly had a strange idea in his heart. He shook his head again and quickly recalled the exercises he had just learned. If he forgot, there would be no place to review them.
He pondered for a moment and then recited in a low voice: "The Jade Slip just talked about the Five Elements Technique of the Yuhu Sect. The so-called five elements are 'gold, wood, water, fire and earth'. Everything in the universe contains the energy of the Five Elements, collectively called 'spirit'. Each sect has its own method of control. The Jade Pot Sect's Technique is to communicate between the 'spirit' in the body and the 'spirit' in the air, and use one's own energy as a medium for control."
Although it sounds awkward, Wu Fan is actually very awkward in his heart. Although he memorizes it very well, he is actually confused. It would be nice if someone could give me some advice, but now even the jade slips that record it are broken, which is really a headache. Seeing that it was getting dark outside, Wu Fan thought that he was waiting to die anyway, so why not give it a try?
Wu Fan remembered that he happened to be introduced to the 'Five Elements-Fire Character Jue' at the beginning, and the first tactic that he came into contact with also impressed him deeply, so he followed the description of the single-line tactic in the jade slip: "The Fire Jue is born from fire, and the five elements restrain fire first. "The word "fire" is the head and the tail, and the five elements are mutually reinforcing and "fire" is practiced. "The five elements are mutually restrained. Fire should be fire, metal, wood, earth, and water, and then fire is the head and tail. The five elements are mutually symbiotic, which means wood generates fire. The front is water, and by the way, it is earth, metal, water, wood, and fire."
After reciting these two sentences, Wu Fan recalled that day when Lu Chun dragged the disciples of the Ninth Academy up the mountain and was talking about Tu Lai, which should be the Tu character formula. Then he was right, so he said nervously: "Fire, metal, wood, earth, water, earth, metal, water, wood, fire, fire is coming!" It was as if the cave was cheering for him, echoing constantly, "Fire is coming, fire is coming, fire is coming!"
Even with the help of the cave, he waited for a long time, but the fire did not come, but the night came, bringing with it a swarm of mosquitoes, buzzing and biting around Wufan. blackFan stamped his feet angrily and thought: Yes! I must have run out of strength! So he put all his strength on the index finger of his right hand, placed it a foot in front of his forehead, pointed at a group of mosquitoes, and shouted loudly: "Fire, metal, wood, earth, water, earth, metal, water, wood, fire, fire is coming!"
I saw a ball of flame rising out of thin air from above my finger, and the mosquitoes were instantly burned to charcoal, and Wu Fan laughed proudly. But those corpses with sparks fluttered and fell, and the small flames burned Wu Fan's brows, just like the bald land on the stone chamber.
A bonfire was raised in the cave room. Wu Fan held two pills in his hand, frowned without eyebrows, and then swallowed the two pills in one gulp. According to the Five Elements Jue, the elements communicated by your own spirit can control whether they can have an effect on you. But just now he wanted to kill mosquitoes, why did he burn himself? Looking at the crackling fire, Wu Fan put his hand over it, and sure enough he felt the heat, which was different from the flame on his fingers just now.
This time Wu Fan restrained his strength and used the magic formula again. This time it was just a small flame. Wu Fan touched it with his hand. The flame was wrapped around his fingers, but Wu Fan could not feel the slightest warmth. So he went to the entrance of the cave, picked up a fallen leaf, and lit it. Sure enough, the temperature of the flame rose. It turns out that it is because one's own spirit has been transferred to other media and turned into other elements in nature.
So he tried a few more times and found that it was indeed the case. This discovery allowed him to fully feel the magic of the spirit in the Five Elements Jue, which might be useful if he encounters an accident in the future. Wu Fan also felt a little tired after trying too many times. The Five Elements Jue used his own strength to control the elements. Wu Fan felt that strength should be strength. Although whether holding a ball of flames or a ball of blazing fire, the physical feeling is the same. But the actual energy consumed is like walking a distance holding a bag of copper coins and carrying a bag of flour.
Therefore, Wu Fan thought that the fundamental of Five Elements Technique was to focus on training one's own quality. Wu Fan couldn't help but feel very entangled. It was obviously a magic, so why did he need to exercise strength when practicing magic. Moreover, it is only a single method now. If it is combined in the future, it will be very tiring. It is strange and confusing. Because Wu Fan used too much strength, the more he thought about it, the more tired he became, and he gradually fell asleep.
Just like this, while reading the jade slips, practicing, and sleeping, Wu Fan's eyebrows grew little by little, and he became more comfortable in controlling the Five Elements Art. After finishing the first two bottles of elixirs, Wu Fan found that even after taking the second bottle, he could still fill his stomach. But there is no longer that magical feeling at the beginning. Is it because of the frequent use of pills that it feels boring now?
In the intervening days, Wu Fan memorized a few more jade slips, and then practiced the remaining four techniques of the Five Elements Art. As the saying goes, one knows everything, and after mastering the Fire Art, the remaining four are relatively easy to master. However, in terms of material nature, fire and water are natural elements, while metal, wood, and earth are material elements. Although it can be communicated with the five elements of the spirit within oneself, fire and water can be extracted and transformed from the heat and humidity of the air, but metal, wood, and earth can only fully play their role in the environment.
So from an attack perspective, the destructive power of fire and water is to destroy objects from the outside world, while metal, wood, and earth are to destroy objects from the environment itself. The more he thought about it, the more confused he became. It was difficult to feel the specific differences and connections just by imagining it. He just rehearsed the subsequent combination of techniques in his mind but did not dare to put them into practice. Although the room in the cave was not big, it was still a place to stay. If there was an accident and it was destroyed by him, he would just bury himself. So I simply put it aside and continued to browse other jade slips.
Ten more days passed in a flashThat day, I saw that there were not many complete jade slips on the cabinet, and most of the techniques had been memorized by Wu Fan. Wu Fan doesn't care whether it's good or bad, black or white, anyway, it's all the things written in the jade slips, and he stuffs them all into his little head. Wu Fan calculated that it had been more than a month since he arrived at Beifeng, but his younger brothers hadn't come to look for him yet. He was secretly angry in his heart. If he could get out later, he would definitely teach them a lesson.
What Wu Fan didn't know was that at this time, those disciples had changed from ants in the pot to frogs in warm water. It was as if their bodies had adapted to this kind of life, their eyes were lifeless, and they were like corpses sitting on flesh. I wonder when a boulder will fall and the pot will leak, allowing these frogs to come to life again.
A few days later, Wu Fan finally finished stuffing the last jade slip, and he felt empty in his heart as he lay on the ground. He seemed to have adapted to this tense and comfortable life. He didn't have to think about other things every day, just repeating the same things he repeated the day before. There was nothing new, but he didn't have to think about what to do in the future. Finally, the day came when he finished reading the jade slips. Not knowing what else to do, Wu Fan fell into a kind of fear.
The elixir seemed to have been carefully planned, but now there is not much left. I have learned a lot of skills but have nowhere to expand. If I starve to death here, it is better to just drink two bottles in one go and just starve myself to death. It would be great if there could be a stone bridge flying outside the cave, just like Lu Chun did...
Thinking of Wu Fan jumping up from the ground, he wanted to give himself a few big mouths. He was wrong to kill the mosquitoes with fire in the first place, and then he went further step by step from here. He only thought about how to use the Five Elements Technique to attack, but he never thought about how to use it. Even during this period of time, I used the fire technique to make fire every day, and I felt like I was attacking wood. Speaking of wood, the cabinets in the stone house are made of wood, and the vines outside the mountain are also of wood nature, and the grass and trees all over the mountains are right in front of me. Like a fool, I keep guarding the fire every day and only know how to play with fire.
Wu Fan was so angry that his chest felt tight. He came to the entrance of the cave and pinched the sword finger with his left hand, which was useless but just for good looks and no one could see it. He opened his right hand slightly, thinking that I would just build a stone wall on the mountain and then I could go up. He was about to shout: "Earth, water, fire, gold and wood, gold, water, wood, fire and earth, come to the earth!"
Just halfway through reciting the Wu Fan Tu Jue, I felt something was wrong in my heart. Suddenly I remembered the hidden cave entrance where he jumped down. It was not high from the ground. Wouldn't it be easier to go up from there? Why bother working so hard here. It was so boring for so long that I felt stupid.
He arrived at the entrance of the cave in despair, and cast the Earth Technique at his feet in a loud and angry voice. There was a rumble under his feet, and a stone pillar rose into the sky under his feet, sending him flying out of the cave entrance. Wu Fan hurriedly put away the soil technique, followed the inertia and flew upward for a certain distance, stopped, fell, and fell to the place where he originally fell unconscious.
